subject: Post-discovery: Alignment, procurement path & internal champion kit
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@northshorehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + suggested procurement/security path

Claire — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Key points I heard
- Primary use case: clinical notes summarization to reduce clinician documentation time by ~30–40%.
- Pilot scope: 3 outpatient clinics, ~25 clinicians, 6 week pilot, dual-model A/B for accuracy checks.
- Decision criteria: accuracy vs baseline, latency under 400ms at 95th percentile, and procurement/PII assurances for PHI handling.

Suggested immediate next steps (my proposed owner)
1) Introduce economic buyer & procurement (Claire) — schedule 30m with Tom Ellis (VP Eng) + procurement to confirm commercial path and licensing model.
2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 summary (Redwood) — Rafael to send SOC2 summary + short security one-pager.
3) Pilot SOW and ROI sketch (Redwood) — Neha will share a one-page ROI model and pilot SOW outline by EOD Fri.
4) Internal champion kit (Claire) — we’ll send a short slide + 2x talk tracks you can use when briefing Tom and procurement.

Quick asks from you
- Can you confirm who in procurement we should loop? (email OK)
- Would Tom be available next Tue 6/9 for a 30m alignment?

Attachments included with this thread: ROI-playbook-NSH.pdf (pilot ROI), Procurement-checklist-NSH.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with Rafael on the SOC2 items and Neha on the ROI.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198


From: Claire Ng <claire@northshorehealth.com>

Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@northshorehealth.com>, procurement@northshorehealth.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested procurement/security path

Thanks Vanessa — clear recap and appreciate the suggested owner map. Quick answers:

- Procurement contact: procurement@northshorehealth.com (I work with them on most vendor engagements).
- Security: copy security@northshorehealth.com on the next package; they’ll need a short SOC2 summary and our standard data flow diagram.
- Economic buyer: Tom is the right person for commercial sign-off. He’s available Tue 6/9 10:30–11:00 PT.

I’ll do a quick champion brief with Tom internally before the call — anything you want me to emphasize? ROI vs clinician time saved will be key; call out integrations with our EHR (Epic) and expected latency SLAs.

—Claire
Director of Clinical Transformation
Northshore Health
claire@northshorehealth.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested procurement/security path

Looping in Ben for presales coverage and to flag what security artifacts we should surface. Quick plan from my side:
- I’ll attach the SOC2 summary (high level) + redwood data flow diagram for PHI handling.
- Offer: we can do a short 1:1 with their security team (30m) to walk through controls and encryption details.
- Time estimate to assemble artifacts: 24–48 hours.

Ben — on the pilot: can you draft a short integration checklist for Epic (what endpoints we expect to call, auth modes) and a latency profile we should commit to for the pilot (I suggest 95th percentile < 400ms for single-utterance generation)?

Also, I recommend the procurement checklist include two commercial options: (A) pilot subscription + conversion credit; (B) committed monthly seat license with a 6–12 month conversion path. Neha, can you sketch those two price frameworks in the ROI doc?

—
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

On Wed, Jun 3, 2026 at 2:10 PM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Claire — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested procurement/security path

Got it — I’ll put together the Epic integration checklist and a short latency & throughput commitment for the pilot. Draft highlights I’ll include:
- Auth: OAuth2 client credentials to a scoped service account; support for token rotation.
- Endpoints: schema for clinical note POST + summary GET; expected payload sizes.
- KV cache guidance: per-session cache to reduce token generation for long notes.
- Pilot SLA ask: 95th < 400ms, 99th < 800ms (we can tier during warm-up).

I’ll attach a 1-page technical checklist and a short sample curl for their infra team. Rafael — want me to include our recommended monitoring hooks for Redwood Console (traces + per-model token cost)?

—Ben
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@northshorehealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@northshorehealth.com>, procurement@northshorehealth.com, security@northshorehealth.com

Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested procurement/security path — confirmed Tue 6/9 10:30 PT

Thanks all — confirmed for Tue 6/9 at 10:30 PT. Agenda for the 30m alignment:
1) Quick intros (5m) — Tom + procurement + Claire + Redwood AE/SE/Presales
2) Pilot scope & success criteria (10m) — accuracy targets, latency SLOs, pilot duration
3) Security & compliance checklist (7m) — SOC2 summary, data flow, encryption
4) Commercial path (8m) — pilot vs committed option and next procurement steps

Internal asks (Redwood)
- Rafael: please bring the SOC2 one-pager and the data flow diagram.
- Ben: short Epic integration checklist and monitoring hooks.
- Neha: one-page ROI with the two pricing options Rafael suggested; include a 6-month projected TCO and clinician-hours saved.

Claire — I’ll share the calendar invite and a 1-slide champion kit you can use with Tom. Attached are the artifacts we discussed. If there’s anything else procurement needs before Tue, please flag.

Calendar invite: Tue, Jun 9, 2026 10:30–11:00 PT
Drive folder with materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNSH-playbook

Best —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
